item.title: The Latest: Oil prices soar after Iran names new supreme leader and launches more attacks
item.description: Iran launched more attacks on Israel and Gulf countries Monday, hours after Iranian state TV said Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei, son of the country’s late supreme leader and long considered a contender, had been named his successor.

item.title: Edge rusher Jaelan Phillips and Panthers agree on a $120 million, 4-year deal, AP source says
item.description: Edge rusher Jaelan Phillips and the Carolina Panthers have agreed on a four-year, $120 million contract, a person with knowledge of the deal told The Associated Press on Monday.

item.title: NC Azalea Festival fourth annual Spring Fashion Show set to kick off in Wrightsville Beach
item.description: The North Carolina Azalea Festival’s fourth annual Spring Fashion Show will take center stage Sunday, March 15, at the Lumina on Wrightsville Beach. The event is sponsored by REV Federal Credit Union

item.title: SBI identifies man killed in downtown Wilmington officer-involved shooting
item.description: The North Carolina State Bureau of Investigation has identified the man who died following an officer-involved shooting in downtown Wilmington early Sunday morning.

item.title: Juvenile charged after bomb threat comment at West Columbus High School
item.description: A juvenile is facing charges after authorities say he told classmates he had a bomb in his backpack at West Columbus High School.

item.title: Wilmington police identify victim in Dawson Street homicide
item.description: Wilmington police have identified the woman killed in a shooting early Sunday morning as a 29-year-old Wilmington resident.

item.title: Downtown Wilmington incident sparks investigation and questions about police response to moving vehicles
item.description: The State Bureau of Investigation is investigating a shooting that occurred in Downtown Wilmington early Sunday morning.

item.title: New Hanover Co. sees drop in foster homes despite fewer children in care
item.description: Over the past five years, New Hanover County has seen a growing need for licensed foster care homes. While the number of children in foster care has dropped, so too have the number of families that can take care of them.

item.title: Question and answer forum for residents held for $50 million Leland town budget
item.description: Town staff is still hammering out their $50 million budget, and the forum gave residents a chance to ask any questions about specific items in it.

item.title: Gas prices jump across Cape Fear region as Iran conflict drives national surge
item.description: Over the past week, the national average for a gallon of regular gasoline has increased by nearly 50 cents, largely due to the ongoing conflict with Iran.
